subject: general
question: Shahid and Mira have to travel from Delhi to Kanpur in their respective cars. Shahid is driving at 132 km/hr while Mira is driving at 60 km/hr. Find the time taken by Mira to reach Kanpur if Shahid takes 5 hours.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When **distance** is constant, **Speed** is inversely proportional to **Time** (S₁T₁ = S₂T₂).

Shahid (S₁) = 132 km/hr, Time (T₁) = 5 hr

Mira (S₂) = 60 km/hr, Time (T₂) = ?

132 × 5 = 60 × T₂ ⇒ T₂ = 660 ÷ 60 = 11 hr

**∴ The correct answer is 11 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of **Shahid** = 132 km/hr

Time taken by **Shahid** = 5 hr

Speed of **Mira** = 60 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c65ddfd18fb1ed5604b0e6ddc74f68090c5d26a0b6f38523dfa7084f7e5494c9.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance (Delhi to Kanpur) = 132 × 5

⇒ Total Distance = 660 km

⇒ Time taken by Mira = Total Distance ÷ Speed of Mira

⇒ Time taken by Mira = 660 ÷ 60

⇒ Time taken by Mira = 11 hr

**∴ The correct answer is 11 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Distance Relation

If distance is constant, speed (S) and time (T) are inversely proportional: S₁/S₂ = T₂/T₁.

Average Speed

When a journey is covered at two different speeds x and y for equal distances, Average Speed = 2xy/(x + y).

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p
